member.summary: This tries to build valid SQL commands on CommandExecuted logs, i.e. logs containing the SQL output by taking the values available from EnableSensitiveDataLogging and inserting them in place of the parameter. This makes it easier to copy the SQL produced by EF Core and run in SSMS etc. LIMITATIONS are: - It can't distinguish the different between an empty string and a null string - it default to null - It can't work out if its a byte[] or not, so byte[] is treated as a SQL string, WHICH WILL fail - Numbers are presented as SQL strings, e.g. 123 becomes '123'. SQL Server can handle that
